sentences.text: If you put food in a box with ice, you have a fridge.
But the ice melts and drips onto the food.
So you add a coil of liquid that boils at minus 26 degrees, and it frosts.
But the coil's liquid boils away, the frost melts and the box warms.
So you add a compressor that squeezes the gas back into a liquid.
Squeezing makes the gas hot, so coils underneath shed that heat.
It holds your food at 4 degrees Celsius.
And the cold is not blown in.
A fridge only moves heat out to the coils outside.
Add a glass door, shelves and a light.
Congratulations, you have built a fridge.
